notes: Every vector is H_FIELDS_V1: preimage = u64_be(len(domain)) || domain || for each field u64_be(len(field)) || field; digest = SHA256(preimage).
Field encoding: string = strict UTF-8 bytes; bytes = raw bytes; uint32/uint64 = 4/8-byte big-endian; bool = 0x00/0x01; enum = uint32 big-endian; frame = domainless NestedFieldFrameV1.

operator_address is encoded as stable address-codec bytes whenever a vector carries it, per this contract. The daily support and identity/bond domains share this rule; no Hub domain frames Bech32 text. A non-Go implementation must decode Bech32 to 20-byte account bytes before framing.
TRUEOPEN_SERVICE_REGISTRATION_V1 binds participant_type immediately after chain_id. This separates Cortex and Builder identity proofs and makes cross_participant_type replay testable.

tamper: XOR one bit of one framed field. "byte" indexes the framed field bytes and may be negative to count from the end; "bit" is the bit position inside that byte (0 = least significant). An absent optional value frames as an empty field and has no bit to flip, so it is covered by a replay case instead.

replay: apply the listed field overrides (keeping the frozen field type) and expect a different digest. Covers cross-chain, cross-operator, cross-participant-type, stale-nonce/version/epoch and list-reorder replay.

beacon_checkpoint_v1 carries a "producer" key and no tamper/replay section. The key names the function TestHubDomainFixtureMatchesProductionHelpers feeds this vector's own inputs to: the digest below is what BeaconCheckpointStep really returns, not only what re-framing fields[] produces. Its per-field sensitivity is derived by TestHubDomainFixtureRejectsEveryFieldBitFlip instead of being published.
Regenerate with TRUEOPEN_REGEN_FIXTURES=1; the run rewrites expectations and then fails on purpose so the diff must be reviewed against the frozen contract.
source: Public wire conformance vectors in testdata/v1/hub/hub_domains_v1.json
